evals.prompt: Design a landing page for Wax & Wane, a small neighbourhood record shop, for people who love the film Paterson and the music of Nujabes.
evals.expected_output: Follow the taste brief: check the setup, plan the Qloo questions with no request, save a frozen prediction and design sketch before any data, then measure and read the Taste Brief before designing.
expectations: Calls mousa_status before any other Moûsa tool
Calls taste_profile with dryRun true, medium web and both references with the audience role
Saves its own prediction and design sketch with design_validate stage prediction before any measured data
Calls taste_profile without dryRun only after the prediction is frozen
Does not write site files before the Design DNA is valid
Never asks for the Qloo API key in the chat

evals.prompt: In styles.css, rename the CSS class .btn-primary to .button-primary and update the two places in index.html that use it.
evals.expected_output: A routine technical change settles no taste decision, so no Qloo plan or measurement is made.
expectations: Does not call taste_profile, taste_ask or qloo_query

evals.prompt: We already measured our audience with Moûsa for this shop. Which of these artists should play in the shop video: Khruangbin, Tom Misch or Nala Sinephro?
evals.expected_output: Answer one taste decision with taste_ask shortlist, writing its own guess first, and report the ranking as Qloo affinity among the candidates.
expectations: Calls taste_ask with question shortlist, the three candidates and kind artist
Writes its own guess in myGuess
Describes the ranking as affinity among these candidates for this audience, not as a score or a certainty
